With over 500 successful projects across 60+ countries, they develop cutting-edge motion platforms, virtual reality experiences, and interactive attractions that have reached over 10 million users worldwide. Professional Experience: Minimum 5 years of proven experience in mechanical and sheet metal design. Technical & Domain Expertise: Strong expertise in technical drawing standards, application-driven projects, and detailed technical design. Solid domain knowledge in materials, electrical systems, automation, and manufacturing processes. Software Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Siemens NX . title: Mekanik Tasarım Mühendisi
description: MEKANİK TASARIM MÜHENDİSİ İlan Hakkında HARPAX Sistem Teknolojileri, hava, kara ve deniz platformlarına yönelik kritik alt sistemlerin geliştirilmesi alanında faaliyet gösteren bir mühendislik şirketidir. ODTÜ Teknokent ofisimize, havacılık yakıt ve yağlama ekipmanları başta olmak üzere, elektro-mekanik alt sistemlerin, gereksinimden doğrulamaya kadar uzanan ürün geliştirme süreçlerine liderlik edecek, çalışma arkadaşları arıyoruz. İş Tanımı • Üst seviye sistem gereksinimlerini alt seviye mekanik tasarım gereksinimlerine dönüştürmek, tasarıma eksiksiz aktarmak ve doğrulama aşamasına kadar izlenebilirliğini sağlamak. • Literatür, standart ve pazar araştırmalarını yürüterek kavramsal tasarım, teknoloji geliştirme, prototipleme ve tasarım olgunlaştırma faaliyetlerini gerçekleştirmek. • İleri seviye 3B modelleme, 2B teknik resim hazırlama, Geometrik Ölçümlendirme ve Toleranslandırma (GD&T) ile tolerans yığılım (stack-up) analizlerini yürütmek. • Üretim ekipleriyle koordineli çalışarak Üretilebilirlik) ve Montajlanabilirlik değerlendirmelerini yapmak; tasarımları performans, güvenilirlik, ağırlık, maliyet ve çevrim süresi ekseninde optimize etmek. • Yapısal, akış ve termal analizlerin gerçekleştirilmesi amacı ile analiz ekipleriyle gerekli girdi ve çıktıların belirlenmesinde rol almak, analiz çıktıları mekanik tasarıma yansıtmak. • Çevresel ve fonksiyonel tasarım doğrulama testlerini test ekipleriyle birlikte yürütmek; testlerde gözlenen uyumsuzlukların kök neden analizlerini (RCA) yaparak tasarım düzeltici faaliyetlerini sonuçlandırmak. • Ürün Ağacı (BOM), Arayüz Kontrol Dokümanı (ICD), malzeme tanımları, montaj talimatları ve tasarım doğrulama raporlarını hazırlamak ve güncelliğini sağlamak. • Tasarım ve değişiklik yönetim süreçlerini kurumsal konfigürasyon, kalite standartları ve havacılık prosedürlerine uygun yürütmek. • Sistem, analiz, test, üretim, kalite, tedarik zinciri ve alt yükleniciler arasındaki teknik koordinasyonu sağlamak; iç ve dış paydaşlara teknik sunumlar gerçekleştirmek. Aranan Nitelikler • Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği, Havacılık ve Uzay Mühendisliği, Uçak Mühendisliği veya ilgili mühendislik bölümlerinden mezun (Tercihen yüksek lisans derecesine sahip). • Mekanik tasarım ve ürün geliştirme süreçlerinde en az 5 yıl sektör tecrübesi olan. • Tercihen pompa, döner ekipman, yakıt/yağlama sistemleri, hidrolik-pnömatik komponentler veya hassas mekanik mekanizmaların tasarımında doğrudan rol almış. • İleri düzeyde 3B parametrik modelleme ve teknik resim bilgisi (Tercihen CATIA V5/V6 tecrübesi; 3DEXPERIENCE veya benzeri PLM platformlarına hakimiyet). • Havacılık malzemeleri, makine elemanları, standart imalat yöntemleri, yüzey ve ısıl işlem süreçleri ile GD&T (ASME Y14.5 / ISO-GPS) standartlarına hakim. • Yapısal (FEA), termal veya hesaplamalı akışkanlar dinamiği (CFD) temel prensiplerini bilen ve analiz çıktılarını yorumlayabilen (Tercihen ANSYS deneyimi). • Havacılık kalifikasyon ve çevresel test standartlarına (MIL-STD-810, RTCA DO-160 vb.) aşina olmak, • Uluslararası literatürü, teknik standartları takip edebilecek ve raporlama/sunum yapabilecek düzeyde ileri teknik İngilizce bilgisi. • Güçlü analitik düşünme, sistematik problem çözme (kök neden analizi) ve çok disiplinli ekiplerle etkin çalışma/iletişim kabiliyeti. • Seyahat engeli bulunmayan, Ankara'da ikamet eden/edebilecek ve erkek adaylar için askerlik hizmetini tamamlamış ya da muaf.

description: Özgün, cesur ve yenilikçi ROKETSAN, fark yaratan yerli ve milli ürünleriyle, küresel hedeflerine doğru ilerlemeye ve ülkemizin gururu olmaya devam ediyor. Türkiye’nin savunma gücüne yön veren projelerde yer alan ekibimizin bir parçası olarak, kariyer yolculuğunuzda fark yaratma fırsatı yakalayabilirsiniz. Şirketimizin Ankara yerleşkesinde görev alacak Mekanik ve Yapısal Tasarım Mühendisi ; Hava-Hava füze sistemlerinin mekanik ve yapısal tasarım faaliyetlerinde; füze gövdesi, mekanik arayüzler, alt sistem yerleşimleri, üretilebilirlik, entegrasyon, doğrulama ve kalifikasyon faaliyetlerinde aktif rol alacaktır. Beklenen Teknik Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği, Havacılık ve Uzay Mühendisliği veya Uçak Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun, Füze, mühimmat, hava aracı veya benzeri yüksek dinamik yüklere maruz kalan sistemlerin mekanik ve yapısal tasarımı konusunda bilgi sahibi, Metalik ve kompozit malzemeler, üretim yöntemleri ve malzeme seçim kriterleri konusunda bilgi sahibi, Mekanik tasarım, boyutlandırma ve geometrik toleranslandırma konusunda bilgi sahibi, Yapısal yükler, titreşim, şok ve termal çevre koşullarının mekanik tasarıma etkileri konusunda bilgi sahibi, Tercihen; Füze, mühimmat veya havacılık sistemlerinin mekanik/yapısal tasarımında deneyim sahibi, MIL-STD-810 çevresel koşul ve kalifikasyon gereksinimleri hakkında bilgi sahibi, ANSYS veya benzeri sonlu elemanlar analiz araçlarını kullanabilen, CATIA ve PLM ortamında mekanik tasarım konusunda deneyim sahibi. Görev ve Sorumluluklar Hava-hava füze sistemlerinin tasarım ve geliştirme aşamalarında mekanik ve yapısal tasarım faaliyetlerinin planlanması ve yürütülmesi, CATIA veya PLM ortamında üç boyutlu mekanik tasarım yapmak ve GD&T uygulamalı teknik resimleri hazırlamak, Füze gövdesi, kapaklar, bağlantı elemanları, kanat/kanatçık yapıları, aviyonik ve diğer alt sistemlerin mekanik yerleşim ve arayüz tasarımlarını gerçekleştirmek, Kütle merkezi, atalet özellikleri, paketleme hacmi ve mekanik arayüz gereksinimlerini tasarım sürecinde takip etmek, Aerodinamik, atalet, titreşim, şok ve termal yükler altında yapısal uygunluğun değerlendirilmesine yönelik analiz ve test faaliyetlerine katkı sağlamak, Hava-hava füzesinin uçak üzerinde taşıma, ayrılma ve fırlatma süreçlerine ilişkin mekanik arayüz ve çevresel gereksinimleri tasarıma yansıtmak, Üretilebilirlik ve montajlanabilirlik esaslarını gözeterek malzeme ve üretim yöntemi seçimlerine katkı sağlamak, EBOM ve ürün varyantlarının oluşturulması ve yönetimi süreçlerinde aktif rol almak, Proje kapsamında ilgili disiplinlerle teknik koordinasyonu yürütmek; prototip, entegrasyon, doğrulama ve kalifikasyon faaliyetlerine destek vermek, Teknik risklerin tanımlanması, değerlendirilmesi ve iyileştirme faaliyetlerinin belirlenmesine katkı sağlamak. ROKETSAN’ın denizlerin altından uzayın derinliklerine uzanan mühendislik faaliyetlerinde, millî teknoloji hedefleri doğrultusunda yürütülen çalışmalara katkı sunarak bu yolculuğun bir parçası olabilirsiniz.

You will maintain accurate BOMs, 3D models, and manufacturing drawings within PLM/PDM systems and SAP. Drive customer approvals for both standard product deliverables and customized mechanical design solutions through effective coordination and communication. Prepare technical documentation, drawings, and work instructions as required. Conduct and support Design and Process FMEA activities to identify potential risks, implement mitigation actions, and improve product reliability and quality. Document all activities, data and information in line with procedures. Provides 3D CAD design, drawings, and required internal documentation. Monitor technological developments and industry best practices in Mechanical Engineering, identify improvement opportunities, and implement approved solutions in alignment with management objectives. Skills Experience with Inventor and/or Creo Direct Modeling, Solidworks Experience with PLM and/or PDM, eg.Model manager, Enovia, SolidWorksPDM or other tooling applications Knowledge of the IEC 62271 series standards. Knowledge about Sheet Metal & Machinig & Welding Manufacturing technologies Knowledge about Power Distribution and Electrical Infrastructure Understanding of mechanical interlocking applications in MV power distribution systems. Advanced proficiency in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills Strong organizational and time management skills Advanced level knowledge of office programs Planning and organization, problem solving, ability of persuasion, working for details, analytical thinking Ability to work within an international, culturally diverse and matrix based organisation. title: Infrastructure Design Engineer
description: We, as Çalık Enerji, offer the energy from nature to the people to build a better and sustainable future.Since its establishment in 1998, the company has become one of the world’s leading energy firms, successfully executing projects across Europe, the CIS, the Middle East, Central Asia, Africa, and the Balkans. Operating in Poland, Hungary, Romania, Switzerland, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan, Libya, Iraq, and Senegal, Çalık Enerji focuses on three main business lines: EPC Contracting, Distribution & Retail, and Renewable Energy Investments. We are looking for "Infrastructure Design Engineer" to join our Engineering Division, based at our headquarters in Istanbul. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related discipline. Minimum 5–10 years of experience in the design of infrastructure works. Strong knowledge of relevant national and international codes and standards. Experience in EPC or industrial facility projects is an asset. Ability to prepare and review design drawings, calculations, BOQs and technical specifications. Proficiency in engineering and drafting software such as Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Hydraflow, SewerGEMS, WaterGEMS, or similar tools. Strong communication and coordination skills, especially within multinational project teams. Good command of English (B2 level or above). No travel restrictions. Responsibilities Perform design and analysis of infrastructure systems, including site grading, drainage, roads, utility networks and pipeline systems. Prepare and review technical documentation such as design reports, calculations, drawings and bill of quantities. Coordinate with internal disciplines, customers and subcontractors to ensure alignment of infrastructure design with overall project requirements. Attend regular project meetings (weekly/biweekly) and provide technical input when required. Support site teams by responding to technical inquiries and providing clarifications. Ensure that design deliverables meet project timelines, standards and quality expectations.

title: Isıtma İklimlendirme Tasarım Mühendisi
description: AHL Mekanik San. ve Tic. A.Ş bünyesinde, Çorum Merkez’de bulunan ofisimizde görevlendirilmek üzere; HVAC projelerimizin hesaplama, tasarım, projelendirme ve teknik dokümantasyon süreçlerinde görev alacak “HVAC Tasarım Mühendisi” arıyoruz. İş Tanımı Isıtma, soğutma ve havalandırma sistemlerinin hesaplama ve projelendirme çalışmalarını yürütmek, Isıtma ve soğutma yükleri, hava debileri ve basınç kayıplarına ilişkin hesaplamaları yapmak, Kanal ve boru boyutlandırmalarını gerçekleştirmek, Proje ihtiyaçlarına uygun cihaz ve ekipman seçimlerini yapmak, Plan, kesit, şema ve uygulama detaylarını hazırlamak, Teknik şartname, keşif, metraj ve malzeme listelerini oluşturmak, Mimari, statik, elektrik ve diğer mühendislik disiplinleriyle tasarım koordinasyonunu sağlamak, Proje revizyonlarını teknik dokümanlara ve çizimlere işlemek, Saha ekiplerine merkez ofisten teknik destek sağlamak, Projelerin teknik şartnamelere, ilgili standartlara ve işveren gerekliliklerine uygunluğunu takip etmek. Aranan Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği bölümünden mezun, HVAC tasarımı ve projelendirmesi alanında en az 3 yıl deneyimli, Isıtma-soğutma yükü, hava debisi, basınç kaybı, kanal ve boru boyutlandırma hesaplarına hâkim, HVAC cihaz ve ekipmanlarının seçimi konusunda deneyimli, AutoCAD programını etkin şekilde kullanabilen, Tercihen Revit MEP ve HVAC hesaplama yazılımları konusunda deneyimli, Teknik şartnamelere ve ilgili standartlara uygun proje hazırlayabilen, Tercihen endüstriyel tesis projelerinde görev almış, Teknik dokümanları inceleyebilecek düzeyde İngilizce bilen, Analitik düşünme, koordinasyon ve problem çözme becerileri güçlü, Detaylara önem veren, planlı ve sonuç odaklı, Çorum’da ikamet eden veya edebilecek.

title: Mekanik Tasarımcı
description: MEKANİK ÇİZİM VE TASARIM UZMANI Rotowash bünyesinde ,İzmir Kemalpaşa'daki üretim tesisimizde görevlendirilmek Mekanik Çizim ve Tasarım Uzman ı arayışımız bulunmaktadır. Aranan Nitelikler Makine Mühendisliği mezunu. Makine tasarımı ve ürün geliştirme alanında en az 7 yıl deneyimli. SolidWorks programını ileri seviyede kullanabilen, PDM veya revizyon yönetimi konusunda deneyimli. Sac metal, kaynaklı imalat ve talaşlı imalata uygun tasarım yapabilen. Mekanik komponent seçiminde (motor, redüktör, rulman, mil, zincir, kayış vb.) deneyimli. Mühendislik hesaplarını yapabilen ve tasarım kararlarını teknik verilerle doğrulayabilen. Üretilebilirlik, montaj kolaylığı, servis kolaylığı ve maliyet odaklı tasarım yaklaşımına sahip. Teknik resim, montaj resmi ve ürün ağacı (BOM) hazırlayabilen. Prototipten seri üretime kadar ürün geliştirme süreçlerinde aktif görev almış. Üretim ekibiyle sahada birlikte çalışabilecek ve tasarımlarının arkasında durabilecek. Tasarımlarında maliyet, üretim süresi ve servis kolaylığını birlikte değerlendirebilen. Standart makine elemanları ve hazır komponent kataloglarını etkin kullanabilen. Görev Tanımı Yeni ürünlerin mekanik tasarımını ve ürün geliştirme süreçlerini yürütmek. Mevcut ürünleri performans, kalite ve maliyet açısından geliştirmek. Üretime uygun, sürdürülebilir ve servis edilebilir tasarımlar geliştirmek. Teknik dokümantasyonu eksiksiz hazırlayarak üretime devretmek. Prototip doğrulama, üretim devreye alma ve tasarım iyileştirme çalışmalarını yönetmek. Üretimden gelen geri bildirimleri mühendislik çözümlerine dönüştürmek.

title: AR-GE MEKATRONİK MÜHENDİSİ
description: ​EN AZ 7 YIL ELEKTRONİK KART VE GÖMÜLÜ SİSTEM DENEYİMİ OLAN ÜST DÜZEY MÜHENDİS ARAMAKTAYIZ. ​Elektronik eğitimlerinde öncü ve lider bir kurum olarak, üniversiteler ve devlet kurumlarıyla iş birliği içinde projeler yürütmekteyiz. Ana faaliyetlerimiz olan eğitim, AR-GE, İŞ-GE ve ÜR-GE alanlarında uzman kadromuzla hizmet veriyoruz. Otomotiv, medikal, enerji(batarya) ve genel elektronik alanlarında proje, teknik servis ve eğitim faaliyetlerinde bulunan ekibimize katılmasını istediğimiz Uzmanın yetkinliklerine dair bilgiler aşağıdaki gibidir... ​Kurumumuz hakkında: Anadolu Yakası'nda Kadıköy yakınında konumlanan firmamıza ulaşımı değerlendirmeniz ve buna göre başvuruda bulunmanız ricadır. ​Aranan Nitelikler ve Şartlar: ​Mekatronik Mühendisliği Mezunu ​Elektronik tasarımında yetkin, özellikle Altium Designer kullanarak Multi-layer PCB ve güç kartları ile haberleşme odaklı kartlar tasarlamış ve tasarladığı cihazlar aktif kullanılmakta olan... ​SPI, I2C, USART, UART, CAN Bus, Modbus gibi gömülü sistem haberleşme protokollerinde bilgi sahibi ve kendi tasarladığı kartın test yazılımlarını kendisi yapabilen... ​Diksiyonu düzgün, etkili beden diline sahip ve eğitmenlik yapmayı gönülden isteyen, ​AR-GE, ÜR-GE ve İŞ-GE faaliyetlerinden keyif alan, enerjik, ​Elektronik kart üretim sürecinde deneyimli, ​Osiloskop, multimetre, lojik analizör, spektrum analizörü, sinyal jeneratörü gibi elektronik arıza bulma cihazlarında deneyimli ve arıza tespiti, elektronik kartların test ve onarımında yetkin (medikal, ECU, otomotiv elektroniği ve endüstriyel elektronik dahil tüm kart türlerinde), ​İyi derecede İngilizce bilgisi (tercihen), ​Ekip çalışmasına yatkın, güçlü iletişim becerileri olan ve çözüm odaklı, ​Dinamik bir çalışma ortamında esnek ve hızlı problem çözme yeteneğine sahip, Askerlik Hizmetini Tamamlamış...

title: Product Development Team Member
description: Farplas is a leading automotive supplier providing parts, equipment, and services for major automotive manufacturers globally, including Toyota, Renault, Hyundai, Ford, Tofaş-Fiat, and Togg. With a wide range of products, Farplas delivers innovative solutions through advanced technology and high-quality production processes. The company focuses on quality and efficiency with its advanced manufacturing facilities and automation systems. Embracing a sustainability-driven and environmentally friendly approach, Farplas aims to increase its competitive power as a dedicated solution partner. Would you like to make a difference on this journey, where we embrace the values of persistence, passion, people, purpose, progress and planet? What Does a Product Development Team Member Do at Farplas? Analyze customer needs and requirements to develop interior and exterior trim part designs that meet both functional and aesthetic expectations. Select appropriate engineering materials (PP, ABS, PC, TPO, etc.) by considering part performance and manufacturing requirements. Take an active role in the creation of initial prototypes and in determining and interpreting the virtual and physical validation tests required for product verification. Ensure design suitability for plastic injection molding processes prior to mass production; continuously improve designs and processes to reduce costs, enhance quality, and increase manufacturing efficiency. Create development schedules aligned with customer project plans throughout all phases of product development and optimize designs to eliminate unnecessary costs. Conduct research on new plastic injection technologies, tooling innovations, and material developments to keep products technologically up to date; improve designs through the use of recyclable materials and part integration opportunities. Collaborate closely with engineering, manufacturing, and quality departments while maintaining continuous communication with customers and stakeholders to ensure project requirements are clearly understood and achieved. What Are the Requirements for a Product Development Team Member at Farplas? Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in plastic injection part and system design within the automotive industry. Advanced 3D modeling skills in both part and assembly environments (preferably using CATIA V5). Knowledge of PLM systems (preferably Enovia, Teamcenter, or similar platforms). English proficiency at B1 level or above. Strong technical knowledge and hands-on experience in plastic injection molding processes and manufacturability. Ability to interpret virtual analysis results and physical test outcomes. Proficiency in reading technical drawings and applying GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing) principles. Passionate about engineering design, with an international mindset and vision. Open to continuous learning and self-development, with a dynamic and proactive approach. Strong analytical, reporting, presentation, and project follow-up skills. Customer-oriented mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions. Residing in, or willing to relocate to, the Asian side of Istanbul or Kocaeli region. What Does the Recruitment Process Look Like? Submit Your Application Competency-Based Interview Assessment Tools Reference Check Final Steps & Offer You can explore all job and internship opportunities at Farplas via LinkedIn and Kariyer.net. If you share our passion and values, we look forward to meeting you,

title: Research, Simulations
description: Employment type: Full time - Hybrid Compensation: 250.000 – 500.000 TL net per month · equity · private health insurance About Talp Talp is simulation infrastructure for enterprise decisions. We build a company’s customer base from its own behavioral data so decisions can be tested before they are made, and we already work with large enterprises across three regions. We are the wind tunnel for decisions. What we install stays and sharpens every time it runs, which is why we call it infrastructure rather than a tool. Testing decisions this way will soon be as ordinary as version control. We have raised $2.2 million to date, most recently at a $25 million valuation, from Formus Capital, Sunshine Lake Ventures, Aito Capital, the a16z Scout Fund, and a group of GPs and founders. The Role Everyone in this field renders the simulation. Nobody renders the proof. Confidence scores, calibration methods, benchmarks measured against human evidence. None of it has been published by anyone in this category, and the company that publishes it first will define how everybody else gets measured. That is the center of this job. You will participate in shaping our scientific direction and turn research into working systems. Your scope spans modeling, evaluation, and the infrastructure that supports experimentation and deployment. This is a hands-on role. You will design experiments, write code, inspect data, and work closely with engineering. You should be comfortable asking difficult scientific questions and taking full responsibility for how they are answered. Responsibilities Shape the research direction: Identify the most valuable questions, prioritize experiments, and connect scientific progress directly to product improvements. Develop and improve models: Work across data preparation, model adaptation, training, and fine-tuning. Reproduce relevant research, challenge its assumptions, and test approaches against strong alternatives. Define how quality is measured: Design benchmarks and experiments that assess behavioral accuracy, consistency, and usefulness. Compare simulations against human evidence while accounting for uncertainty, population variance, and data limitations. Build reliable evaluation systems: Develop repeatable workflows for comparing models, investigating failures, and detecting regressions. Keep datasets, experiments, and results strictly traceable, protecting evaluation data from leaking into development. Combine human and automated judgment: Create clear scoring criteria, review processes, and automated evaluators, then verify that those evaluators consistently agree with qualified human reviewers. Make research practical to run: Partner with engineering on data pipelines, experiment tracking, training workflows, and model serving to maximize iteration speed, reliability, and compute efficiency. Carry improvements into production: Follow promising results through implementation and deployment, verifying that their advantages hold outside the original experiment. Set the scientific standard: Establish clear standards for rigor, and communicate findings through technical writing, publications, and external collaborations. Who You Are Applied Research Record: A strong track record in applied AI or machine learning research, with evidence of taking ideas from experiments into working production systems. Deep Model Experience: Hands-on experience with language models, modern training/fine-tuning techniques, and rigorous model evaluation. Core Engineering Skills: Strong Python skills and deep familiarity with frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX. Sound Statistical Judgment: You reason intuitively about sampling, uncertainty, and bias, and can tell immediately whether an apparent improvement is statistically meaningful. Systems & Tooling Ownership: Experience building or owning research tooling, evaluation pipelines, or ML infrastructure that other engineers rely on. High Agency: The ability to drive technical work autonomously and make clear decisions even when the empirical evidence is incomplete. Intellectual Honesty: Clear communication and the willingness to discard an approach the moment the data challenges it. Typically five or more years of relevant AI or ML research experience. Relevant academic research counts toward this; we also welcome candidates with exceptional demonstrated impact on a shorter timeline. Valuable Additional Experience Behavioral science, computational social science, causal inference, or experimental design Synthetic data generation, human feedback loops, annotation systems, or complex behavioral datasets Multi-agent systems and simulations involving interacting populations Distributed training, GPU optimization, or efficient model serving You do not need equal depth in every area. We look for deep research instincts combined with strong engineering ability. A PhD is welcome but not required. Our Process We prioritize thoughtful conversations and clear examples of past work. Our hiring process is designed to help both sides align on mutual fit, working style, and expectations. Reapplication Policy: To ensure a fair and thorough evaluation for all applicants, Talp observes a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. Equal Opportunity Talp is an equal opportunity workplace. We welcome applicants of every background and identity. If you need support or an accommodation at any point in the process, let us know and we will arrange it.

description: Description du poste et Missions Fives Xcella recherche activement un Ingénieur Conception Mécanique F/H pour venir renforcer ses équipes à Larmor-Plage, en CDI. Ensemble, nous œuvrons au quotidien pour faire de l’industrie une réponse aux grands défis de notre temps : technologiques, environnementaux, sociétaux, économiques. Comment ? En inventant et en concevant, depuis plus de 200 ans, les solutions et technologies qui améliorent concrètement et durablement le quotidien de chacun d’entre nous. En intégrant Fives Xcella, vous rejoignez une start-up du Groupe Fives et filiale au cœur de la stratégie de développement de la Division Smart Automation Solution, conçoit et développe des solutions de stockage automatisé de dernière génération pour optimiser les flux intralogistiques des plus grands acteurs du e-commerce, de la distribution, et l’industrie. Vous aussi, rejoignez-nous pour faire aimer l’industrie ! Nous recherchons actuellement un Ingénieur Conception Mécanique F/H, animé par cette même envie de faire rayonner l’industrie. Et comme chez Fives, nous avons toutes et tous notre rôle à jouer pour atteindre notre but commun, le vôtre sera de concevoir des sous-ensembles mécaniques en étroites collaborations avec le chef de projet, les service mécatronique, informatique et achat. Vos missions seront les suivantes : Concevoir les architectures matérielles capables de répondre aux spécifications techniques d’avant projets ou de développement, Conduire les études mécaniques sur les bases des exigences négociées (coût, performance, poids, ergonomie, …), Participer à la rédaction des analyse fonctionnelles et des analyses de risques, Garantir les cotations fonctionnelles et géométriques, Définir et conduire les tests de validation des prototypes retenus et leurs évolutions dans le temps, Animer les calculs des éléments mécaniques avec le module de calcul par éléments finis de solidworks, Contribuer à construire et à alimenter une base de données RETEX des fonctions mécaniques réalisées sur la gamme produit. Des déplacements de courte durée sont à prévoir sur les sites clients et/ou fournisseurs. Au sein de Fives Xcella, et sous la direction du Responsable BE, vous intégrerez l’équipe du Bureau d’Etudes Mécaniques. Si c’est vous, rejoignez-nous ! Nous recherchons une personne diplômée en d’une école d’ingénieur généraliste ou spécialisée en mécanique, avec une expérience significative (4 à 7 ans) dans la conception et le dimensionnement de structures mécaniques et de mécanismes (idéalement orienté machines spéciales). Vous avez des compétences affirmées en calcul de structure. Vous avez de solides connaissances en fabrication mécanique (usinage, soudage..) et vous savez utiliser un système de gestion de données. Outre vos compétences techniques, vous êtes passionné(e) et vous vous distinguez par votre curiosité intellectuelle et votre esprit créatif. Votre sens pratique et votre détermination dans la recherche de solution seront des atouts prépondérants pour ce poste. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? En rejoignant Fives, vous intégrerez un groupe international qui vous donnera accès à de multiples opportunités d’évolution et de mobilité, et ce, dans de nombreux domaines. Nous vous offrirons toute la place pour apprendre, grandir et vous épanouir, sur le plan professionnel, notamment grâce à nos programmes d’intégration et d’accompagnement, mais également sur le plan personnel. En effet, vous pourrez bénéficier d’un mode de travail hybride et de nombreux autres avantages [aide au logement, mutuelle, tickets restaurants, etc.]. Au travers de ses recrutements, Fives Xcella cultive une politique en faveur de la diversité, de l'égalité professionnelle et de l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés. Alors, rejoignez l’industrie qu’on aime !

title: Ingénieur(e) calcul en mécanique des structures H/F/D F/H
description: Travaillant au sein de l’équipe « Technology » de l’ingénierie Produit, l’ingénieur(e) calcul pour l’intégrité mécanique devra réaliser des études statiques et dynamiques des composants et assemblages des produits nucléaires, et contribuera au développement des outils et méthodes associés. Les produits nucléaires incluent la turbine à vapeur, les échangeurs thermiques, l’alternateur, les pompes et leurs systèmes auxiliaires. Ce rôle consiste principalement à évaluer l’intégrité mécanique de produits nucléaires (turbine, alternateur, pompes, échangeurs de chaleur, etc.) et à développer des méthodes et outils pour les analyses d’intégrité mécanique statique, dynamique et thermomécanique. Les principales activités sont les suivantes : Réaliser des analyses d’intégrité mécanique par la méthode des éléments finis sur des composants, conformément aux critères de dimensionnement et aux règles et instructions internes. Modéliser des structures complexes à l’aide du logiciel de maillage HyperMesh et effectuer des simulations par éléments finis sous ANSYS. Personnaliser les modèles, automatiser les cas de charge et effectuer des post-traitements avancés à l’aide du langage APDL (Ansys Parametric Design Language). Réaliser des analyses statiques et dynamiques (modales, sismiques, harmoniques, transitoires), ainsi que des études de durée de vie (fatigue, nocivité, propagation de fissures). Effectuer des calculs mécaniques linéaires et non linéaires (non-linéarités de contact, de comportement matériau et de géométrie). Intégrer les exigences des codes (CODAP, EN 13445, ASME, RCC-M) dans les études de dimensionnement des appareils à pression. Prendre en charge les analyses mécaniques dans le cadre de l’exécution des projets et/ou du développement produit. Rédiger les rapports d’analyse d’intégrité mécanique conformément aux exigences qualité et aux plannings définis. Vérifier les calculs et analyses réalisés par d’autres membres de l’équipe. Assurer le suivi technique des activités sous-traitées. Contribuer au développement et à l’harmonisation des outils, processus de calcul et à la capitalisation du savoir-faire. Respecter les règles et instructions EHS propres à l’entreprise. Diplôme d’ingénieur ou doctorat dans le domaine du calcul d’intégrité mécanique. Minimum 5 ans d’expérience dans le domaine du calcul mécanique de structures par éléments finis. Excellente maîtrise des outils ANSYS (APDL) et HyperMesh ; la connaissance de CATIA est un atout. Bonne connaissance des codes et standards applicables aux appareils à pression (CODAP, EN 13445, ASME, RCC-M). Connaissance des machines tournantes Capacité à lire, analyser et interpréter des plans de fabrication et des documents d’ingénierie. Aptitude à travailler dans un environnement motivant et exigeant. Leadership et capacité à piloter des activités techniques complexes. Bon relationnel, esprit d’équipe et capacité à représenter le service dans un environnement multidisciplinaire et international. Disponibilité pour des déplacements occasionnels en France ou à l’étranger (principalement en Europe). Bon niveau d’anglais.

title: MAIT Additive Manufacturing Engineer
description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation. We want you as a talented MAIT Additive Manufacturing Engineer to help us in our mission by contributing significantly to Additive Manufacturing (AM) technology, development and in-house production for our Vehicles Nyx Earth and Nyx Moon. The ideal candidate will play a key role as an MAIT Additive Manufacturing Engineer, working on the development and qualification of additive manufacturing (AM) processes, including the definition of print parameters for new materials. This role will also involve supporting the certification of AM components to comply with high industry standards, including NASA regulations. Role Overview As an MAIT Additive Manufacturing Engineer, you will play a key role in the development, qualification, and industrialization of Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF) technologies for critical aerospace hardware. You will support the full lifecycle of aerospace hardware, from manufacturability assessment and process development through qualification, certification, and production readiness. Working closely with Design Engineering, Materials & Processes, Quality, Testing, and Manufacturing teams, you will contribute to the delivery of flight-ready components across TEC's propulsion and space systems programs. This is a technically demanding role with direct impact on flight hardware development, manufacturing capability, and future production scalability. Key Responsibilities Own the manufacturing and qualification of mission-critical flight hardware. Develop, optimize, and qualify LPBF processes for a range of high-performance alloys. Define and manage material characterization campaigns, support test execution, and analyze the resulting data. Take over build preparation, LPBF process simulation, and process monitoring data analysis. Execute qualification and certification activities for AM hardware in accordance with aerospace requirements and internal quality processes. Troubleshoot manufacturing challenges and drive continuous improvement in process capability, quality, productivity, and inspection methodologies. Author technical documentation and collaborate with internal teams, external suppliers, laboratories, and certification bodies. Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Aerospace Engineering, or related field. Hands-on experience with metal LPBF systems in an industrial environment. Experience in LPBF process development, material and part verification. Knowledge in material characterization methodologies, including the selection and interpretation of material property and mechanical testing data. Proficiency in CAD for part design modification, LPBF build design, and support generation. Experience with Siemens NX and PLM tools such as Teamcenter is a plus. Strong communication, analytical problem-solving, and effective collaboration across multidisciplinary and international teams. Fluent in English. Preferred Qualifications 3+ years of experience in LPBF process and hardware qualification for complex aerospace propulsion systems. Strong understanding of DFAM principles, LPBF process physics and parameters. Familiarity with aerospace materials such as nickel-based superalloys, titanium alloys, copper alloys, as well as stainless steels. Refractory alloys is a plus. Hands-on experience in machine operation, material characterization, including metallography, microstructural characterization, and mechanical testing. Proficiency in additive manufacturing process simulation solutions. Why you should join us! What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is: We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge? We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable. All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible. If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

title: Newly graduated Mechanical Engineers at Novo Nordisk Engineering
description: Does the idea of using your mechanical expertise to help build the world’s largest pharmaceutical facilities excite you? And do you thrive on tackling complex challenges and developing with each new task in a dynamic project environment? Then you’ll fit right in! Who We Are We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere. Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you. About The Role We are looking for newly graduated mechanical engineers, marine engineers or related educational backgrounds to ensure that our customers get the best-in-class mechanical consultancy in their projects ranging from conceptual design up until installation and commissioning. You will be a part of a highly skilled and supportive team of more than 280 colleagues across our 8 mechanical departments where you will work on large-scale projects currently in the production phase that will challenge and develop your skills. Why do we need you? Our aim is to assist our customers in establishing efficient, sustainable and intelligent facilities for API production. Your role will be crucial in delivering top-notch mechanical consultancy, ensuring our customers receive the best possible service. It is therefore essential that you have the ability to gain a broad understanding of mechanical engineering principles and to have a keen interest in the pharmaceutical industry to excel in this role Location Denmark - Kalundborg Experience Graduate level Department Mechanical KA II How You Might Spend Your Days As a newly graduated Mechanical Engineer, you’ll be: Specifying and dimensioning mechanical equipment, piping systems and technical components Supporting installation, construction and commissioning activities on large-scale pharmaceutical projects Participating in Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT) Collaborating with contractors, suppliers and multidisciplinary engineering teams Contributing to technical assessments and problem-solving throughout project execution Who You Are We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are: Thrive in a dynamic project environment where priorities can evolve as projects progress Communicate clearly with colleagues, customers and stakeholders Take a structured and organised approach to your work Are curious and motivated to continuously learn and develop your technical skills Are positive, resilient and solution-oriented when facing challenges What You Bring To The Role In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role: You have recently graduated, or expect to graduate within the next six months, with a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering or a related technical discipline Through studies, projects, hobbies or practical experience, you have developed an interest in mechanical equipment and technical systems You are comfortable working in a highly regulated environment where quality, documentation and traceability are key You are fluent in written and spoken English Life at NNE NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more. At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs. We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth. You can read more about the benefits we offer here . Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you. Deadline of application is 15 October 2026 Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact on or Lars Lundberg Kristensen at +45 3075 8534. Please note: We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV We invite to interviews on a running basis. Fair hiring At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV. Still searching for the right opportunity? If this position isn’t quite what you're looking for, but you know someone who would excel in this role, please share this job post. And don’t forget to explore our other exciting opportunities — your future role at NNE might be just around the corner! Visit our Career Site

title: Junior mechanical engineer
description: Ontwerp wat beweegt, tilt en draait Als junior mechanical engineer werk je aan techniek die letterlijk in beweging is. Denk aan containerkranen van honderd meter hoog, het beweegbare dak van de Johan Cruijff ArenA of offshore windplatforms midden op zee. Jij ontwerpt en rekent aan onderdelen die onder zware omstandigheden moeten blijven functioneren. Binnen infra en water werk je aan beweegbare bruggen, sluizen, gemalen en waterzuiveringen. Je ontwerpt aandrijvingen en bewegingswerken die elke dag betrouwbaar moeten functioneren. In offshoreprojecten werk je aan hijsvoorzieningen en mechanische onderdelen van windplatforms. Binnen de industrie ontwerp je constructies voor fabrieken en procesinstallaties. En in de maritieme sector werk je mee aan de mechanica van onderzeeboten en marineschepen. Je werkt ontwerpen uit van concept tot detail. Je maakt berekeningen op sterkte, stijfheid en vermoeiing, toetst aan normen en denkt mee over maakbaarheid en onderhoud. Je stemt af met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines zoals civiele techniek, elektrotechniek en procestechnologie. Je ziet hoe jouw ontwerp onderdeel wordt van een groter geheel. Bij Iv werken we aan projecten die anderen soms voor onmogelijk houden. We houden van ingewikkelde vraagstukken, maar niet van moeilijk doen. De lijnen zijn kort, de lat ligt hoog en je krijgt snel verantwoordelijkheid. Je start met begeleiding, maar groeit snel door naar zelfstandige taken. Wil je je verdiepen in ontwerp, modelleren of juist richting projectcoördinatie? Dan krijg je daar de ruimte voor. Jouw ambitie bepaalt je route. Wat verwachten we van jou? Hbo- of wo-opleiding Werktuigbouwkunde Interesse in maritiem, offshore, gebouwen of infraprojecten Analytisch sterk en zorgvuldig Goede communicatieve vaardigheden Je spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands Wat hebben we jou te bieden? Een uitdagende en gevarieerde baan bij het meest diverse ingenieursbureau van Nederland! Zo kun je rekenen op: De gaafste projecten in alle sectoren: je werkt aan hoogwaardige oplossingen waar de maatschappij écht iets aan heeft. Van ’s werelds grootste offshore windplatformen, bruggen en sluizen tot fabrieken, waterzuiveringsinstallaties en onderzeeboten. Een professionele én gezellige werkomgeving: bij Iv vind je een laagdrempelige werksfeer waarin hard werken hand in hand gaat met plezier. Zo bezoeken we tweejaarlijks het EK- of WK-voetbal, vieren we nieuwjaar groots in de Efteling, organiseren we gezellige zomerbarbecues en nog veel meer! Flexibele arbeidsvoorwaarden: kies voor meer salaris, extra vakantiedagen of beide! Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden: 31 vakantiedagen, jaarlijkse gratificatie (7%), winstuitkering, flexibele pensioenregeling en reiskosten- en thuiswerkvergoeding. Ruime ontwikkelmogelijkheden: we bieden talloze mogelijkheden tot het volgen van opleidingen, cursussen en trainingen om nóg beter te worden in je vak. Kortom: bij Iv werk je samen met 1400 andere specialisten aan de grootste uitdagingen van deze tijd én beleef je veel plezier. Dat noemen wij: engineering that excites.

title: Marie Curie PhD vacancy (DC8) for PhD research titled "Additive manufacturing of ceramics with complex surfaces for small-scale turbomachinery"
description: The PhD research will be carried out in the Advanced Ceramics and Powder Metallurgy team at the Department of Materials Engineering of KU Leuven. KU Leuven (University of Leuven) has been a center of learning for nearly six centuries since 1425, making it one of the oldest and most renowned universities in Europe. Today, it is Belgium’s highest ranked university (QS 2025 : 60), ranked among the top 4% universities in the world and consistently ranked in the top 10 most innovative universities in Europe. The university caters to over 60,000 students from more than 140 countries. KU Leuven's three doctoral schools provide internationally oriented PhD tracks for more than 4,000 doctoral students. KU Leuven and affiliated knowledge institutes provide fertile ground for innovation and high-tech entrepreneurship in the Leuven region. This favorable climate for knowledge-driven innovation makes the Leuven region an attractive location for many high-tech companies. KU Leuven website: https://www.kuleuven.be/english/kuleuven/ Project KU Leuven seeks a highly motivated PhD candidate for a fully funded, four-year international doctoral position within the Marie Sklodowska-Curie Doctoral Network (MSCA-DN) project TURBO-IMPACT (TURBOmachinery Innovative Manufacturing, Processing, Analysis, Characterization, and Topology ; Website: https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101311350). The TurboImpact project, funded by Horizon Europe – MSCA-DN, tackles challenges in designing, optimizing, selecting materials, and manufacturing small-scale turbomachinery for applications in heat pumps, fuel cells, organic Rankine cycles, or gas turbines. This project develops robust system and component design methods, an integrated manufacturing platform, and multi-material joining techniques to efficiently produce small-scale turbomachinery. In this EU project, this PhD researcher (DC8) will focus on the complete indirect DLP/SLA additive manufacturing route for silicon nitride turbomachinery components. This involves the development of a UV-curable Si3N4 slurry, optimization of DLP/SLA printing strategies for reference parts and complex components such as impellers, and the post-printing debinding and sintering process to obtain fully dense complex near-net-shaped ceramic components. The AM parts will be microstructurally, mechanically and geometrically characterized. Simple geometries will be used for the evaluation of joining and machining performances, whereas the complex near-net-shaped components will be applied in turbomachinery. The Doctoral Candidate Will Develop a UV-curable Si3N4 slurry and optimize DLP/SLA printing strategies for reference parts and complex components Realize post-printing debinding and sintering processes to obtain fully dense complex near-net-shaped ceramic components Elucidate the processing – microstructure – mechanical properties – geometrical accuracy correlations. The project includes potential international secondments at EPFL (Switzerland), Admatec Additive Solutions (The Netherlands) and IFW (Germany). The researcher is supervised by Prof. Jozef Vleugels (https://www.kuleuven.be/wieiswie/nl/person/00006337), head of the Functional Materials Division (FUNMAT) and coordinator of the Advanced Ceramics and Powder Metallurgy research group at the Department of Materials Engineering. The research group has a long track record (>35 years) on the powder metallurgical development, processing and characterisaton of ceramics, cermets, metcers and metals. More information on the website (https://www.mtm.kuleuven.be/english/research/siem/ACPM) Profile I have a two-year master degree in Materials Science, Materials Engineering, or an equivalent master degree. I am proficient in written and spoken English. During my courses, master thesis or prior professional activities, I have gathered basic experience on the processing of ceramics, additive manufacturing, microstructural and mechanical characterization or I have a profound interest in these topics. I demonstrate a strong sense of initiative and responsibility, while also being an effective and collaborative team player. I am very motivated and obtained good grades (minimum distinction level) I feel comfortable to work as a team member and I am eager to share my results to inspire and be inspired by my colleagues. Special requirements: In accordance with the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network regulations: Applicants must comply with the MSCA Mobility Rule. At the time of recruitment, candidates must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in the hiring Country for more than 12 months during the 36 months immediately preceding recruitment. Applicants must be doctoral candidates (i.e., not already hold a doctoral degree) and be eligible under the MSCA Doctoral Network rules at the time of recruitment Short stays such as holidays, compulsory national service, or time spent as part of a refugee procedure are not considered. Applicants must have a two-year master's degree in Materials Engineering, Materials Science, or an equivalent master degree , or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree. Offer Successful Candidates Will Be enrolled in the KU Leuven PhD programme, Conduct research in a stimulating international environment with access to state-of-the-art facilities and supervision by recognised experts Participate in local and network-wide training activities aimed at advancing scientific knowledge and transferable skills, Attend workshops and international conferences relevant to their research topic, Undertake secondments of approximately 4–6 months at other network or associated partner institutions. title: NUMERICAL MODELING ENGINEER
description: ELKEME was founded in 1999 to support the Hellenic Metallurgical Industry. Through a variety of state-of-the-art laboratories, we focus on industrial research and technological development/analysis in four major metal sectors (Aluminum, Copper, Steel and Zinc). Our mission is to provide high business value to customers by developing efficient and sustainable solutions to technological and business challenges and by contributing to the improvement of their capabilities and competitiveness. We are seeking a highly motivated and innovative Simulation Engineer / Research Scientist to join our team at the Oinofyta facilities. The ideal candidate will contribute to the development and application of advanced finite element and numerical models for structural, thermo-mechanical and manufacturing processes, supporting industrial problem-solving and process optimization. The role focuses on advanced simulation, predictive modeling, and industrial research projects. The successful candidate will combine strong analytical and programming skills to develop innovative engineering solutions. Responsibilities Develop finite element models for structural, thermo-mechanical, and manufacturing processes. Simulate metal forming, extrusion, rolling, fracture, fatigue, crashworthiness, and material behavior. description: Travaillant au sein de l’équipe « Technology » de l’ingénierie Produit, l’ingénieur(e) calcul en intégrité mécanique réalise des analyses statiques, dynamiques et thermomécaniques sur les composants et assemblages des produits nucléaires. Ces produits incluent notamment la turbine à vapeur, l’alternateur, les pompes, les échangeurs de chaleur et leurs systèmes auxiliaires. Le rôle comprend également la contribution au développement et à l’amélioration des méthodes et outils dédiés aux analyses d’intégrité mécanique, afin de garantir la fiabilité et la performance des équipements. Les missions clés : Réaliser des analyses d’intégrité mécanique par la méthode des éléments finis sur des composants, conformément aux critères de dimensionnement et aux règles et instructions internes. Modéliser des structures complexes à l’aide du logiciel de maillage HyperMesh et effectuer des simulations par éléments finis sous ANSYS. Personnaliser les modèles, automatiser les cas de charge et effectuer des post-traitements avancés à l’aide du langage APDL (Ansys Parametric Design Language). Réaliser des analyses statiques et dynamiques (modales, sismiques, harmoniques, transitoires), ainsi que des études de durée de vie (fatigue, nocivité, propagation de fissures). Effectuer des calculs mécaniques linéaires et non linéaires (non-linéarités de contact, de comportement matériau et de géométrie). Intégrer les exigences des codes (CODAP, EN 13445, ASME, RCC-M) dans les études de dimensionnement des appareils à pression. Prendre en charge les analyses mécaniques dans le cadre de l’exécution des projets et/ou du développement produit. Coordination technique entre les équipes calculs MI et les équipes design et de management de projet. Représente l’activité calcul MI au sein de revues d’avancement projet Proposer, planifier et exécuter les activités de projet en lien avec le responsable de l’équipe Intégrité Mécanique, incluant la mise en œuvre de méthodes et d’outils de calcul adaptés. Rédiger les rapports d’analyse d’intégrité mécanique conformément aux exigences qualité et aux plannings définis. Vérifier les calculs et analyses réalisés par d’autres membres de l’équipe. Assurer le suivi technique des activités sous-traitées. Contribuer au développement et à l’harmonisation des outils, processus de calcul et à la capitalisation du savoir-faire. Promouvoir le savoir-faire et l’image du département. Agir conformément aux valeurs et au code d’éthique de l’entreprise. Respecter les règles et instructions EHS propres à l’entreprise. Diplôme d’ingénieur ou doctorat dans le domaine du calcul d’intégrité mécanique. Minimum 10 ans d’expérience dans le domaine du calcul mécanique de structures par éléments finis. Excellente maîtrise des outils ANSYS (APDL) et HyperMesh ; la connaissance de CATIA est un atout. Bonne connaissance des codes et standards applicables aux appareils à pression (CODAP, EN 13445, ASME, RCC-M). Connaissance des machines tournantes. Capacité à lire, analyser et interpréter des plans de fabrication et des documents d’ingénierie. Aptitude à travailler dans un environnement motivant et exigeant. Leadership et capacité à piloter des activités techniques complexes, et assurer le suivi de projets (engagement et adhérence au planning, pilotage des études, reporting…). Bon relationnel, esprit d’équipe et capacité à représenter le service dans un environnement multidisciplinaire et international. Disponibilité pour des déplacements occasionnels en France ou à l’étranger (principalement en Europe). Langues : Français indispensable, bon niveau d’anglais.
